lines.text: The LORD has a case against the people of the land, where lying, murder, stealing, and adultery are rampant.
Because of this the land mourns, and all who dwell in it waste away with the beasts and birds.
Because they rejected knowledge, the LORD will reject them as His judges and forget their children.
Though Israel prostitutes itself, Judah should avoid such guilt and not journey to Joppa or Beth-aven.
The whirlwind has wrapped them in its wings, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
